name: GhostKbd
description: Headless native kbd for inline keyboard-shortcut display. useGhostKbd owns key-token labels and SSR-safe platform detection; GhostKbd is the thin unstyled element. Themed keycap chrome lives on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: keys
props.description: Key tokens rendered as nested kbd elements. A string is one key; an array is a combination. Tokens are matched case-insensitively. Unknown tokens render as given, except a single letter is uppercased.

props.name: platform
props.description: Modifier label set. auto uses PC labels until after mount, then Apple labels when the browser looks like Apple. Explicit apple and pc are deterministic from the prop.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Key content. When keys is omitted, this is the entire kbd contents. When keys is set, this is appended after a plus separator as extra combination content.

parts.name: key
parts.description: Nested kbd for one token from the keys prop.

parts.name: separator
parts.description: Literal plus between keys. Stays in the accessibility tree.
